scripts.name: STRATUS - AWS - Change IAM user password
scripts.description:
Stratus Red Team cloud adversary-emulation technique for AWS.

Change IAM user password

Establishes persistence by updating a Login Profile on an existing IAM user to change its password. This allows an attacker to hijack an IAM user with an existing login profile. Warm-up: - Create an IAM user with a login profile Detonation: - Update the user's login profile to change its password References: - https://www.invictus-ir.com/news/the-curious-case-of-dangerdev-protonmail-me - https://expel.com/blog/incident-report-from-cli-to-console-chasing-an-attacker-in-aws/ - https://permiso.io/b

Morgana executes the official Stratus technique using an isolated MORGANA_TEST_ID correlation ID. Prerequisite infrastructure is handled by Stratus warmup. Cleanup uses the same correlation ID.
scripts.command:
# Stratus Red Team — Change IAM user password
# Correlation ID = Morgana Test ID for Detection Fabric correlation
STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID="${MORGANA_TEST_ID:-$(uuidgen 2>/dev/null || cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/uuid 2>/dev/null || echo manual)}"
export STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID

if [ -n "#{stratus_aws_profile}" ]; then export AWS_PROFILE="#{stratus_aws_profile}"; fi
if [ -n "#{stratus_aws_region}" ]; then export AWS_DEFAULT_REGION="#{stratus_aws_region}"; fi

# Select Stratus binary for this Agent OS
if command -v stratus >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  STRATUS_BIN=stratus
else
  STRATUS_BIN="{{asset:stratus_linux_amd64}}"
  chmod +x "$STRATUS_BIN" 2>/dev/null || true
fi

echo "[INFO] Stratus Red Team: technique=aws.privilege-escalation.iam-update-user-login-profile"
echo "[INFO] Correlation ID: $STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID"

# Warmup + Detonate
"$STRATUS_BIN" detonate aws.privilege-escalation.iam-update-user-login-profile
EXIT_CODE=$?

echo "[INFO] Detonation complete: exit=$EXIT_CODE technique=aws.privilege-escalation.iam-update-user-login-profile"
# Emit structured result
echo "MORGANA_RESULT_METADATA={\"provider\":\"stratus-red-team\",\"technique_id\":\"aws.privilege-escalation.iam-update-user-login-profile\",\"correlation_id\":\"$STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID\",\"exit_code\":$EXIT_CODE}"
exit $EXIT_CODE
scripts.cleanup_command:
# Stratus Red Team cleanup — uses SAME correlation ID as detonation
# MORGANA_TEST_ID must match the value used during detonate
STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID="${MORGANA_TEST_ID:-manual}"
export STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID

if command -v stratus >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  STRATUS_BIN=stratus
else
  STRATUS_BIN="{{asset:stratus_linux_amd64}}"
fi

"$STRATUS_BIN" cleanup aws.privilege-escalation.iam-update-user-login-profile
CLEANUP_EXIT=$?
echo "[INFO] Cleanup complete: exit=$CLEANUP_EXIT technique=aws.privilege-escalation.iam-update-user-login-profile"
exit $CLEANUP_EXIT
